name: @tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell
description: Shell execution, file I/O, and directory listing tools for the TPMJS Agent Sandbox

tools.name: shellExec
tools.description: Execute a shell command in the sandbox workspace. Supports git, npm, and any CLI tools.

tools.name: readFile
tools.description: Read a file from the sandbox workspace.

tools.name: writeFile
tools.description: Write or create a file in the sandbox workspace.

tools.name: listFiles
tools.description: List files and directories in the sandbox workspace.
